attrs.formula: Revenue from operations, after intercompany eliminations in scope
Revenue year to date / same months last year - 1, cut at the last month with data
Revenue - cost of sales - operating expenses
EBITDA x effective stake % (derived, not shown on the CFO Cockpit)
Trade payables / trailing 3-month cost of sales x 91
Intercompany revenue and purchases removed on consolidation when both sides are in scope

attrs.thesis: Premium personal care in the US, Australia and Germany: grow fast, keep the margin, fix cash collection
Hydraulics leadership in India and Europe: steady growth, protect the margin, tighten receivables
India consumer franchise: distribution-led growth at a mid-teens margin
Medical imaging JV: steady growth at a high-teens margin
Hydraulic pumps, motors and valves for Indian machinery: localise and grow double digit at a mid-teens margin

props.sample: Advertisement, Freight Inward, Office & Admin Expenses, Wages & Salaries
Sales - Hydraulic Pumps, Sales - Motors & Valves
Purchase - Imported Components, Purchase - Local Components
